chk_events_time.name: chk_events_time
chk_events_time.value: ("events"."start_time" IS NULL AND "events"."end_time" IS NULL) OR ("events"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."end_time" > "events"."start_time")

chk_exams_time.name: chk_exams_time
chk_exams_time.value: ("exams"."start_time" IS NULL AND "exams"."end_time" IS NULL) OR ("exams"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "exams"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "exams"."end_time" > "exams"."start_time")
